q: How long does standard delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery within the United States takes 3 to 5 business days [shipping#1]. If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!

q: Is shipping free on a $45 order?
answer: Shipping is free on orders of $50 or more. For orders below $50, standard delivery costs $5.95 [shipping#2].

q: How many days do I have to return something?
answer: You have 30 days to return most items from the date of delivery. The items must be unused and in their original packaging [returns#1].

q: Can I return a gift card?
answer: Gift cards cannot be returned [returns#2]. If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!

q: How long is the warranty on a floor lamp?
answer: The warranty on a floor lamp is 2 years against manufacturing defects [warranty#1].

q: Can I pay by bank transfer?
answer: We do not accept bank transfers as a payment method. We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Larkspur Home gift cards instead [payments#1].

q: When will my card be charged?
answer: Your card is charged when the order ships, not when it is placed [payments#2]. If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!

q: How many reward points do I earn per dollar, and what are 100 points worth?
answer: You earn 1 point for every dollar spent [loyalty#1]. Additionally, 100 points are worth $5 off a future order [loyalty#2].
